context: Reconcile overlap with already approved 5.x native conditions and introduce only Flat-Footed and Helpless as distinct states. This is not an import of every 3.0/3.5 condition.

decisions.change: Normal, Touch and Flat-Footed AC share contribution-based resolution, with attack-target selection separate from defender status. Combined Touch and Dexterity-denied attacks are supported.
Half Speed, deny positive Dexterity and dodge defenses, -2 AC, own attacks Disadvantage; replace attacks-against Advantage instead of stacking. No blind-only 50% miss roll.
Deny positive Dexterity and dodge defenses against attackers other than the grappler; keep speed, targeting and ending provisions.

An attack from an unseen Invisible creature denies target's positive Dexterity and dodge defenses; replaces this condition's attack Advantage. Attacks against Invisible still have Disadvantage when attacker cannot see it.
Replace attacks-against distance Advantage/Disadvantage with -4 AC melee/+4 AC ranged. Own attack Disadvantage and standing cost remain.
Maintain half Speed and faltering speech; deny positive Dexterity/dodge and apply -2 AC instead of granting attacks-against Advantage. Do not automatically drop gear.
Add distinct Flat-Footed condition: deny positive Dexterity and dodge defenses and disallow opportunity attacks, without automatically disallowing every Reaction.
Add distinct Helpless condition: Dexterity treated as 0 for AC, -4 against melee from exposure; no unconsciousness or loss of actions implied by Helpless alone.
Inherit Helpless in addition to Incapacitated, remove duplicate attacks-against Advantage; retain close-range automatic critical hits.
Inherit Helpless and Prone alongside Incapacitated; replace attacks-against Advantage with effective AC adjustments, retain critical hits, unawareness, object drop and recovery state.
No additional implied Unconscious or Helpless. Preserve awareness flexibility, material defenses and current attack Advantage until separately decided.
Preserve 5.x baseline; 3.x initiative -4 and verbal spellcasting failure are deferred.
Preserve 5.x baseline; compulsory flight and fear tier relationships deferred.
Preserve 5.x attack Advantage; no parallel AC conversion approved for this non-overlapping 3.x condition.

deferred: Source-specific grappling action economy and multiple-grappler targeting
Coup de grace and physical helplessness procedures
Cross-edition AC contributions and exception grants as runtime behavior
rights: Only paraphrased native mechanics are stored here; keep full upstream text, if imported later, with its appropriate Open Game License and attribution, separate from CC BY 4.0 5.x source pack.
